verdict.rationale: Exa documents natural-language web search over its own index, which is the core of this story. It returns relevant excerpts and offers search types from ~250 ms instant up to deep-reasoning search. Community users praise the search API and agree SERP/keyword-style results are the wrong interface for LLMs, though relevance misses are reported for Websets and the older Metaphor engine. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of embedding/neural semantic retrieval, and independent head-to-head evidence that it finds results keyword engines miss.
